biggest_catch: Bonus tiers scale with DD totals: the $750 tier requires $20,000+ in direct deposits within 90 days plus transaction requirements - the effective effort for the top tier is high. Bankbonus.com reports the offer expires 12/31/2026, but the official page excerpt does not show an end date.
catches: Offer available for clients who do not have an existing or prior personal checking account at Dedham Savings.
Open a Free & Easy Checking account online and enter promo code 'Select'.

Complete balance and transaction requirements within 90 calendar days of account opening: bonus based on qualifying direct deposits ($2,500+ = $250; $10,000+ = $500; $20,000+ = $750) PLUS 5+ debit card transactions totaling $100+ or 5+ Bill Pay transactions totaling $100+.
Bonus credited to the account within 90 days after requirements are met.
Offer expiry 12/31/2026 is from aggregator (bankbonus.com) only; not shown in the official page excerpt.

eligibility: No existing or prior personal checking account at Dedham Savings; Dedham Savings serves Massachusetts (aggregator states MA).

steps: Open a Free & Easy Checking account online at Dedham Savings and enter promo code 'Select' when prompted (Enter/Add Promo Code).
Within 90 calendar days of account opening, receive qualifying direct deposits totaling the target tier amount ($2,500+ / $10,000+ / $20,000+).
Within the same 90 days, complete 5+ debit card transactions totaling $100+ or 5+ Bill Pay transactions totaling $100+.
Bonus is credited to the account within 90 days after requirements are met.
timing: Bonus credited within 90 days after requirements are met.
